subject: English
central_question: How can a student accurately change direct statements and questions into reported speech by adjusting tense, pronouns, time/place words and word order?
in_scope_units: Reported speech and backshift in statements
Yes/No questions with if or whether
banned_topics: Commands, Requests and Exclamations in Reported Speech

known_pitfalls.claim: Keeping direct-question word order in reported questions.
known_pitfalls.correction: Use statement word order after the question word or if/whether.

known_pitfalls.claim: Forgetting the usual backshift after a past reporting verb.
known_pitfalls.correction: Shift the listed tense or modal one step back, such as is->was or will->would.

known_pitfalls.claim: Omitting if/whether in a reported Yes/No question.
known_pitfalls.correction: Introduce a Yes/No reported question with if or whether.

recommended_example_progression: Report a simple statement with tense backshift
Practise modal and tense backshift patterns
Report Wh-questions and correct word-order errors
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Typical CBSE practice includes rewriting direct statements and questions in reported speech, completing backshift and time-word changes, and correcting connector or word-order errors.
